payout_quote: Get $300 - Chase Total Checking: For new Chase checking customers: Open a new Chase Total Checking account and set up direct deposit within 90 days of offer enrollment... To receive the checking bonus: 1) Open a new Chase Total Checking account, which is subject to approval; AND 2) Have your direct deposit made into the new checking account within 90 days of coupon enrollment. Your direct deposit needs to be an electronic deposit of your paycheck, pension or government benefits (such as Social Security) from your employer or the government. Person to Person payments (such as Zelle) are not considered a direct deposit... After you have completed all the above checking requirements, we'll deposit the bonus in your new account within 15 days... Offer expires 10/14/2026. (Official Chase offer page snapshot, terms captured 2026-09-23)
timing: Bonus deposited within 15 days of completing the direct-deposit requirement (90-day window)
eligibility: New Chase checking customers only; not available to existing checking customers or those whose accounts were closed within 90 days; one checking bonus every two years; account subject to approval
steps: Open a new Chase Total Checking account online with the offer code (by October 14, 2026)
Set up direct deposit (paycheck, pension, or government benefits) into the new account within 90 days of enrollment
Confirm the deposit is a real employer/government electronic deposit - Zelle and micro-deposits do not count
The $300 bonus posts within 15 days of completing the requirement
catches: Direct deposit means employer/government electronic deposits only - Zelle, cash, checks, wires, and micro-deposits do NOT count
Not available to existing Chase checking customers or anyone who closed a Chase checking account within 90 days; one bonus per two years

$15 monthly service fee unless waived ($500+/month in qualifying electronic deposits, $1,500+ daily balance, $5,000+ average linked balances, or linked qualifying account) - no fee for the first two statement periods
Bonus is taxable interest reported on Form 1099-INT
Account must not be closed or restricted at the time of payout
biggest_catch: The $300 requires a real employer/government direct deposit within 90 days - Zelle and personal transfers don't count - and the offer expires October 14, 2026.
